    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    DATELINE is built on the conviction that journalistic fluency is a strategic capability — not a natural talent alone. Every module pairs business-English precision with editorial judgment, media literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium journalism leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern journalism — from the foundations of news writing and fact-checking to AI-powered news production and data journalism.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — source interviews, editorial reviews, legal checks, breaking coverage — written for international journalism professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    B.G.
    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. DATELINE reflects his vision: journalistic fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and editorial credibility.

    Designed for the reporters, editors, and newsroom leaders shaping how the world understands what's happening — DATELINE is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for holding power accountable and telling the truth clearly.
